title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Park Houses, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Me Planimetri Perfekte !

title_en: At Rezidenca Park Houses, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan!
description_en: At Rezidenca Park Houses, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with perfect floor plan! Modern comfort inspired by nature! Park Houses brings a harmony between modern architecture and nature, creating an oasis of calm, elegance and comfort. Surrounded by greenery and characterized by contemporary design, this residential complex offers carefully curated spaces and premium facilities, being the ideal choice for those who appreciate style, quality and harmony in every aspect of living. The apartment is organized by an entrance with a corridor, a spacious living room connected to the kitchen area and with access to the balcony, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a laundry room.
